description: Get Substack author leaderboards. Defaults to global New Bestsellers; supports category leaderboards (technology, business, etc.) and personalized For You. Returns ranked authors with publication, avatar, and subscriber info. Requires Chrome remote debugging.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Leaderboard category slug. Use 'new-bestsellers' for the global New Bestsellers list, 'for-you' for personalized recommendations (requires login), or any category slug such as technology, business, finance, culture, news, science, etc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of leaderboard entries to return (1-200). The command aggregates API pages internally because the API does not support a limit parameter.
